reviewer.imagery_policy: Satellite RGB imagery only; independent manual boundaries.

dataset.description: Separate Astra satellite-only visual forest approximation; preserves default forest_patches.json and splits fresh traces into at most 500 m cells.

source.primary_imagery: Sentinel-2 L2A true-colour RGB only; no orthophoto boundaries or prior forest polygon constraints.
limitations: Approximate manually interpreted canopy extent, not a forest inventory or surveyed boundary.
Only visible RGB satellite imagery was used; no infrared bands, classifier, orthophoto tracing or old polygon intersection.
Native resolution is 10 m; narrow roads, small structures, canopy gaps and mixed pixels are not reliably resolved.
Dense woods are included; sparse park trees, narrow hedgerows and ambiguous mixed urban strips are generally omitted.
Confidence labels are qualitative visual judgements; image acquisition date is 2025-08-13, not a current-ground guarantee.
Five metre canopy inset and clearing margins only reduce mixed-pixel edge uncertainty; they do not improve image resolution.

subdivision.boundary_policy: Shared grid boundaries do not overlap; components below 2500 m² and clipped fragments below 100 m² omitted.
